findings.title: Testimony held to an even line
findings.claim: The focus command gives justice the shape of testimony held to an even line: public witness and the judgment it supports remain aligned with an equitable measure while hostile pressure is present.
findings.mechanism: The focus joins knowledge-based witnesses to the definite equity standard and repeats the justice command; the 5:1 occurrence of divine judging supplies a concrete adjudication contact. Together these contacts make animus a lateral force that the witness and the measure must withstand.
findings.reader_payoff: Justice becomes perceptible as the stabilization of a testimony-and-measure relation under pressure, rather than as an abstract quality detached from what a witness says or a judgment does.
findings.containment: This is a bounded testimony and adjudication image attached to 5:8. It does not make the whole legal sequence of 5:1 the focus, turn every related root sense into the ayah's meaning, or state a wider surah thesis.

epistemic.reason: The candidate and its supports are trusted, and the relevant focus and context carriers are supplied with exact branch records or exact projected context occurrences.

findings.title: The withheld hand
findings.claim: The focus also forms a bodily pattern of hostile force being stopped: hatred loads conduct toward aggression, an extended hand is intercepted before it becomes an accountable deed, and justice redirects the force.
findings.mechanism: The focus's causative warning and named hatred meet 5:2's repeated sequence and explicit boundary-crossing, while 5:11 supplies intended hands, extension, restraint, and the bodily instrument of deeds. The same focus justice and protection terms hold the interruption in an ethical direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The warning becomes an intelligible interval between resentment and action: the reader can see where hostility is stopped before it reproduces itself through a person's own hand.
findings.containment: The hand is a bounded contextual image for the focus's restraint of hostility; 5:8 does not narrate the 5:11 event, and the image does not replace testimony, equity, or the primary justice command.

epistemic.reason: Trusted candidate supports and exact supplied focus/context surfaces establish distinct hatred, causation, extension, restraint, and accountable-action contacts.

findings.containment: This is a surprising ritual-to-ethical material analogy, retained as attributed and exploratory; it is not a lexical definition of justice, not a claim that 5:8 prescribes ablution for testimony, and not a replacement for the focus's plain command.

findings.title: Justice kept on a straight course
findings.claim: The explicitly added Fātiḥa ayat add a bounded straightness overlay: the focus's sustained standing and repeated justice can be pictured as keeping a balanced course, while deviation names the direction from which hostility can turn it.
findings.mechanism: The external 1:6 occurrence of al-mustaqim supplies a straight-course trigger for the focus carrier qawwamin and the external 1:7 occurrences of the straight path and straying supply a deviation trigger for the focus's available adl deviation branch. The contacts return through the focus's standing and justice words rather than announcing a whole-surah theme.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's justice command gains an orientation image: impartiality is not only an even measure at a point but a course that must be kept from bending under enmity.
findings.containment: Only 1:6 and 1:7 are used, as individually listed external ayat. This overlay does not recast 5:8 as a Fātiḥa commentary, claim a complete path channel, or displace the native testimony, equity, and justice readings. The other added Fātiḥa ayat supply no distinct local delta beyond the retained native/pericope findings.

epistemic.reason: The external context supplies exact ayah surfaces, root occurrences, and individual word positions, while the lean projection omits full context morphology and no separate support trust label is supplied; the overlay is therefore bounded and exploratory.
